metadata.title: Sasakian Hodge Numbers of Calabi-Yau Links
metadata.abstract: The link of an isolated weighted homogeneous hypersurface singularity whose degree equals the sum of its weights is a Sasakian manifold that admits a contact Calabi-Yau structure, and its Sasakian Hodge numbers are dimensions of graded pieces of the Milnor algebra of the defining polynomial. In earlier work these numbers were computed with Gröbner bases for the $7$-dimensional links of $7549$ of the $7555$ weighted Calabi-Yau threefold links, and two conjectures were raised from the data. The first asserts that polynomials with the same weights have Milnor algebras whose relevant graded pieces have equal dimensions; the second asserts that the Sasakian Hodge number $h^{2,1}_S$ of the link is bounded above by the Hodge number $h^{2,1}$ of the base Calabi-Yau threefold. Both conjectures are proved here. The first holds for every polynomial with an isolated singularity, because its partial derivatives form a regular sequence; an independent derivation of the Sasakian Hodge numbers by sheaf cohomology on the leaf-space orbifold is also given. For the second, the stringy Hodge numbers of the Calabi-Yau orbifold are shown to bound the middle Sasakian Hodge numbers in every dimension $n\ge2$, and for $n\ge3$ the gap in $h^{n-1,1}$ is shown to be a sum of geometric genera of loci of orbifold points; for threefolds the bound is attained exactly when all curves of orbifold points are rational. The resulting closed formulae give the Sasakian Hodge numbers of the six $7$-dimensional links left open in the earlier work and complete datasets for all $95$ five-dimensional K3 links and all $1\,100\,055$ nine-dimensional Calabi-Yau fourfold links; for the K3 links they recover the previously known second Betti numbers.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 加权 Calabi–Yau 链结的 Sasakian Hodge 数
analysis.workSummary: 对次数等于权重和的孤立加权齐次超曲面奇点，以偏导数正则序列给 Milnor 代数分次维数公式，推出固定权重和次数的 Sasakian Hodge 数一致。另以叶空间 orbifold 的层上同调独立导出。
techniques: 加权 Milnor 代数与正则序列
叶空间 orbifold 层上同调
stringy Hodge 数与奇异轨迹几何亏格
analysis.breakthrough: 复维 n≥2 时，底 orbifold 的 stringy Hodge 数控制中间 Sasakian Hodge 数。n≥3 时 h^(n−1,1) 的差写成 orbifold 点轨迹的几何亏格和，三重体等号恰在所有 orbifold 曲线均为有理曲线时成立。闭公式补齐此前缺失的 6 个七维链结，并给 95 个五维 K3 链结及 1,100,055 个九维链结的数据。
analysis.limitations: 偏导数正则序列的论证以孤立奇点为前提，链结的接触 Calabi–Yau 和 Hodge 比较还使用加权齐次与次数条件。三重体的等号判别是特定维数的表述。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 声明称 Claude Fable 大量协助两项核心猜想的证明，探索策略并生成初版论证，之后由作者审阅。Claude 帮助写初稿，Claude 和 GPT Astra 继续辅助修订。第7页将早先的实验数据及机器学习辅助解读联系到猜想的形成。作者对数学内容负责，部分证明表述还在完善。
